item: League games played (sum of club games)
derivation: Two clubs play each game, so the sum of club games played is divided by 2.

item: Total points scored in the league
derivation: Sum of PF across all 32 clubs.
Sum of PF divided by sum of club games played.
Sum of PA divided by sum of club games played. Equals the PF mean when the league is closed.

item: Spread of club scoring (SD of points per game)
derivation: Population standard deviation of each club's points per game.

item: Mean club point differential per game
derivation: Sum of (PF - PA) over sum of club games; 0 in a closed league.
sqrt(2) x the club-level scoring SD. This is a modelling assumption, not an NFL statistic.
